text.p: These are the leading stories in Mozambique's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambican Culture Minister Mateus Katupha has announced that a United Nations-controlled international fund is to be created to support the restoration of architectural treasures on Mozambique Island, a Unesco "world heritage" site off the country's northern coast.

- The Mozambican Commercial Association has accepted a government assurance that exemption from import duty granted to a new Maputo shopping centre, to be opened by the South African firm Shoprite on August 28, applies only to goods on the shelves on that date, not to goods in warehouses or future imports.
- Representatives of European youth organisations are in Maputo to seek forms of co-operation with their Mozambican counterparts.
